A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Select own set completion or deny rival almost-completed set; remember hand likely to return, delay a card you expect safe, use chopsticks to capture competing options at cost of returning an exploitable card.

Take a seat
How to play
Three players each receive seven cards. Each chooses one face down, all reveal into scoring tableau and pass remaining hand left; repeat to exhaustion, three rounds with alternating direction. Six card families: pairs worth5; triples worth10; each dumpling increasing1/3/6/10/15; roll-icons most6/second3; sauce doubles next single nigiri2/3/4; desserts remain across rounds and majority+6/minority−6 at match end. A once-per-round chopstick card already drafted may be returned into passing hand to take two cards from current hand. Fixed public score reference. Tied roll places share that bonus rounded down. If all dessert counts tie, no dessert bonus or penalty applies.
Most points after third-round dessert adjustment wins; equal draws, otherwise loss.

A once-per-round chopstick card already drafted may be returned into passing hand to take two cards from current hand. Fixed public score reference. Tied roll places share that bonus rounded down. If all dessert counts tie, no dessert bonus or penalty applies.
Most points after third-round dessert adjustment wins; equal draws, otherwise loss.
